subject.title: [AI-assisted] Preserve thread sessions across daily reset by default

question: Should external channel/thread closure be represented permanently as the core-reserved persisted `sessionClosedAt` field exposed through the plugin session-store runtime?
rationale: The field changes durable session state and the plugin-visible reserved-slot contract; correctness tests cannot choose the long-term ownership boundary.

options.title: Approve the canonical marker
options.body: Keep `sessionClosedAt` as the single lifecycle signal and require every session reader and writer to preserve or clear it intentionally.

options.title: Encapsulate with an SDK operation
options.body: Expose a generic mark-session-closed operation while keeping the persisted representation private to core.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Defer closed idle/no-expiry rollover until maintainers select another lifecycle contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the canonical marker
recommendation.body: Keep `sessionClosedAt` as the single lifecycle signal and require every session reader and writer to preserve or clear it intentionally.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most strongly connects this owner to reset policy, rollover behavior, Discord/plugin boundaries, and reserved session-entry fields.
